annotation.title_clean: 100 Days Mission: Reducing the impact of future pandemics by making Diagnostics, Therapeutics and Vaccines available within 100 days (filed as "AI for Science Strategy - GOV.UK")
annotation.title_en: 100 Days Mission: Reducing the impact of future pandemics by making Diagnostics, Therapeutics and Vaccines available within 100 days
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Pandemic Preparedness Partnership (report to the UK G7 Presidency)
annotation.summary_en: The 2021 report by the Pandemic Preparedness Partnership to the UK-hosted G7 sets out a '100 Days Mission' to make diagnostics, therapeutics and vaccines available within 100 days of a pandemic threat. Despite being filed as an 'AI for Science Strategy', it has no AI or robotics content.
key_provisions_or_claims: Aim for safe, effective diagnostics, therapeutics and vaccines within 100 days of a WHO PHEIC declaration
Prioritise R&D on prototype DTVs for priority viral families, expanding CEPI to cover therapeutics and diagnostics
Create an international clinical trials network and harmonised regulation
Set WHO 'rules of the road' for pandemics and a pre-funded DTV financing facility
Establish a G20 Global Health Board and require equitable access clauses in funding
